title: Polostan

description.main: The first volume of Neal Stephenson's Bomb Light series, a historical espionage novel set in the United States and the Soviet Union in 1933 and 1934.
description.extended:
Polostan is the first volume of Bomb Light, a planned historical-fiction series about the dawn of the Atomic Age.

The novel is set in the Soviet Union and the United States in 1933 and 1934. It follows Dawn Rae's early life as she moves between the two countries and is groomed as a spy for the organization that later became the KGB. Figures and events of the decade appear along the way, among them George S. Patton, Lavrentiy Beria, and the Century of Progress. William Morrow published the hardcover on October 15, 2024.

Where Termination Shock (2021) looked ahead to a near-future climate crisis, Polostan looks back to the 1930s. The series continues with D: Heavy Water, published in October 2026 as the second Bomb Light volume.

notes: First US hardcover edition (William Morrow, 2024). Volume one of the Bomb Light series.
